verdict.rationale: Reader has no documented batch/bulk endpoint for submitting many arbitrary URLs at once; the closest evidence is that its search endpoint automatically fetches and converts the top 5 search results in one call, which is a narrow, non-configurable form of multi-item processing. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch API accepting an arbitrary list of URLs, documented concurrency/rate limits for bulk use, and any hands-on confirmation of large-scale batch runs.
